description:
Who, if anyone, must sign off on this task's output before it is
considered final — generalizes the per-stage STAGE_APPROVE_ROLES table
(app/services/permissions.py, Phase 00 baseline section 10) and the
Implementation Run accept/reject gate (section 7) into one reusable
shape. `approval_roles` uses plain strings, not app.models.enums.UserRole
directly — this package must stay importable without a hard dependency
on the application's own ORM/enum layer (this is a wire contract, meant
to also be consumable by an out-of-process runtime), so role names are
validated as non-empty strings, not as members of that specific enum.

approval_roles.description: Role names permitted to approve this task's output, e.g. ['TECH_LEAD']. Empty with requires_human_approval=True means 'any authorized reviewer' — a resolver-level policy decision, not resolved here.
approval_roles.title: Approval Roles

escalation_roles.description: Optional additional roles notified if approval is overdue — advisory only, not enforced by this contract.
escalation_roles.title: Escalation Roles

requires_human_approval.description: False only for a task type/stage explicitly configured to complete without a review gate — mirrors WorkflowNode.requires_human_approval.
requires_human_approval.title: Requires Human Approval

title: ApprovalPolicy
